description: Check the 6-digit code from start_signup and create the user's Weav workspace. Returns a setup_key that the setup tools accept for 24 hours, so setup can continue in chat. If the email already has a workspace, tells you to have the user sign in instead. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the Weav email.

company_name.description: The user's company or brand name; used as the workspace name. Ask the user.

name: verify_signup_code
title: Finish Weav signup
